PRESCOTT COILL, BALLINRUANE, KILMEEDY, CO. LIMERICK
Exceptional 5-Bedroom Family Residence on a Beautiful Countryside Setting .

Nestled in the peaceful and picturesque surroundings of Ballinruane, Kilmeedy, Co. Limerick, this impressive detached five-bedroom residence offers generous living accommodation, superb outdoor facilities, and beautiful countryside views. Situated on approximately 10.1 acres of mature forestry and woodland, the property enjoys exceptional privacy and seclusion, creating a truly unique rural retreat. Combining spacious family living with excellent equestrian amenities, this home is ideal for those seeking a relaxed countryside lifestyle with ample space both inside and out.

The home is well designed throughout, offering bright, spacious interiors, multiple reception rooms, and a seamless flow between living spaces.

Ground Floor Accommodation:
Front Porch – 100.72 sq.ft.
A welcoming entrance porch with tiled flooring, leading into the main reception area.

Reception Hallway – 413.33 sq.ft.
A spacious hallway featuring a solid fuel stove, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the home.

Open Plan Kitchen / Dining / Living Area – 487.89 sq.ft.
The heart of the home, this impressive open-plan space features an American-style fitted kitchen with tiled flooring throughout. A stove set against a striking stone feature wall creates a beautiful focal point, while a large bay window fills the room with natural light. Double doors open directly onto the front decking area, enhancing indoor-outdoor living.

Utility / Back Kitchen – 161.98 sq.ft.
A practical space with tiled flooring and built-in storage, offering excellent functionality for everyday household use.

Sitting Room – 266.58 sq.ft.
A bright and comfortable reception room featuring timber flooring, a fireplace, and a large bay window overlooking the surrounding landscape.

Dining Room – 385.35 sq.ft.
A generously sized dining room with its own stove, ideal for family gatherings and entertaining.

Guest WC – 60.01 sq.ft.
Conveniently located ground floor toilet facility.

Bathroom – 61.37 sq.ft.
Well-appointed ground floor bathroom.

Dressing Room
Offering additional storage and dressing space.

First Floor Accommodation:

Landing – 413.33 sq.ft.
A spacious landing area with access to a private balcony enjoying countryside views.

Bedroom 1 – 389.13 sq.ft.
A large bedroom with carpet flooring, private balcony access, and a fully fitted ensuite.

Bedroom 2 – 383.96 sq.ft.
A spacious double bedroom featuring built-in wardrobes and a bright bay window.

Bedroom 3 – 197.87 sq.ft.
Comfortable carpeted bedroom.

Master Bedroom – 399.28 sq.ft.
A substantial master suite featuring a large bay window, extensive built-in wardrobe space, and a spacious ensuite bathroom measuring approximately 79.58 sq.ft.

Main Family Bathroom
Well-proportioned family bathroom.

Office / Playroom – 112.22 sq.ft.
A versatile room suitable for use as a home office, playroom, or potential fifth bedroom if desired.

External Features:

Garage – 316.67 sq.ft.
A large garage offering excellent storage and workshop space.

Stables (x3)
Three well-maintained stables to the rear of the property, each equipped with water troughs and hay racks, making them ideal for equestrian use.

Tack Room – 134.51 sq.ft.
Dedicated storage space for equestrian equipment and supplies.

Fodder Room – 173.09 sq.ft.
Additional outbuilding ideal for general storage or equipment.

Tree House
A unique outdoor retreat set within the grounds, the tree house offers a cozy, characterful space complete with a built-in stove.

Outside

Located on the picturesque Golden Mile, this magical 10 acre wood offers something that is rare. Your own wild and very private woodland offers endless possibilities and opportunities or to leave as nature intended. Incredible views from all rooms and as far as the eye can see panoramic views from the hill of 5 counties - Limerick, Tipperary, Clare, Cork and Kerry. 

Adding further appeal, the property benefits from a network of scenic walking trails throughout and around the grounds, connecting directly with the surrounding forestry which is a legacy from its days of Heathfield Almost Wild Camping . These trails provide excellent opportunities for walking, hiking, horse riding, and enjoying nature right from your doorstep.

This impressive home combines space, comfort, and versatility, with excellent family accommodation, extensive forestry grounds, outstanding outdoor facilities, and direct access to beautiful countryside trails, all set within a highly desirable and private rural location.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the unique lifestyle, exceptional privacy, and outstanding setting that this remarkable property has to offer.
